parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias of the vulnerability to query.

parameters.name: AssetType
parameters.description:
The Asset Type where the vulnerability is detected. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:
- **ECS**: host asset
- **CONTAINER**: container asset.

parameters.name: AttachTypes
parameters.description:
The vulnerability type. This query condition is valid only for application vulnerabilities. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
- **sca**: software constituency parsing vulnerability
- **app**: application vulnerability.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The container search field. Valid values:

- **instanceId**: instance ID
- **appName**: application name
- **clusterId**: cluster ID
- **regionId**: region
- **nodeName**: node name
- **namespace**: namespace
- **clusterName**: cluster name
- **image**: image name
- **imageRepoName**: image repository name
- **imageRepoNamespace**: image repository namespace
- **imageRepoTag**: image tag
- **imageDigest**: image digest.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the first page to display in the query results. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the results start from page 1.

parameters.name: CveId
parameters.description:
The CVE ID.
> Call the [DescribeVulListPage](~~DescribeVulListPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is handled. Valid values:

- **y**: handled
- **n**: not handled.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Necessity
parameters.description:
The priority of the vulnerability fix to query. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

- **asap**: high
- **later**: medium
- **nntf**: low.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of vulnerability entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 vulnerability entries are displayed per page.

parameters.name: RaspDefend
parameters.description:
Specifies whether Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) supports real-time protection against the vulnerability. Valid values:

- **0**: Not supported.
- **1**: Supported.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is added as one of the member accounts in a resource folder.
> Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: SearchTags
parameters.description:
The label used for filtering. Valid values:

- **Restart required**
- **Remote utilization**
- **EXP exists**
- **Available**
- **Privilege escalation**
- **Code execution**

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The container query type. Valid values:

- **containerId**: container ID
- **uuid**: asset ID.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the vulnerability to query. Default value: cve. Valid values:

- **cve**: Linux software vulnerability
- **sys**: Windows system vulnerability
- **cms**: Web-CMS vulnerability
- **app**: application vulnerability (network scan)
- **sca**: application vulnerability (software constituency parsing).

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUIDs of the servers to query. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
